how_to: What’s the best way to use the Color Twister Lip & Cheek Blush Stick? When first opening the product, remove the safety cap. For easier removal, twist the stick once or twice before pulling the tab. Where should you apply blush on your cheeks? For a sun-kissed healthy-glow effect: Position the stick vertically. Draw a wide horizontal line from cheek to cheek, across the bridge of your nose. Blend in. For a plumping effect: Apply the blush stick only to the rounded part of your cheekbone. Blend with your finger. For a lifted effect: Starting at the outside of your cheekbone (without covering the rounded part), glide upwards towards your temple and blend in the colour.

how_to: For lighter coverage: use the 06 Multi-texture Brush in circular motions across the entire face to blend the product into the skin. Go back over any areas with blemishes or imperfections as many times as you want. For medium coverage: take up the foundation using the white side of the sponge. Start applying the product in the center of the face, then spread it toward the edge of the face. Repeat until the desired finish and coverage is achieved. For high coverage: take up the foundation using the black side of the sponge. Spread the product from the center to the edge of the face. Repeat until the desired makeup result is achieved. You can also use the sponge for touch-ups during the day by dabbing it on the relevant areas. Want to see Sephora Collection’s best tips? There is a QR code on the back of the compact, giving you access to an application tutorial on TikTok. Just use a suitable app on your smartphone to scan the code and discover new tips and tricks!

For optimal application and to preserve the formula, do not wind the bullet more than 2 mm and be sure to close the lid after each use.

how_to: What lipstick colour should I choose? Cream Lip stain offers a wide range of intensely pigmented shades. Whether you prefer rosewood (#86 English rose), deep brown (#123 Brownie), poppy red (#128 Fancy raspberry), or more daring options, there's a perfect shade for you. Explore new possibilities with shades like electric blue (#136 Ultra violet), ultra-bright orange (#137 Neon marmalade), or the bold #126 Hot hot pink, whose name speaks for itself. You can also create custom combinations: for a volumizing effect, apply a darker shade to the edges (#84 Rose redux) and a lighter shade in the center (#122 Casual peach), blending them seamlessly. What’s the best way to apply matte lipstick? 1. Start by exfoliating your lips for a flawless makeup result. 2. Position the applicator in the center of the upper lip. Outline the cupid’s bow, then glide the formula towards the corners of your mouth. 3. Repeat the same process for the lower lip, starting from the center and moving towards each corner. Tip: pair Cream Lip Stain with Lip Stain Liner for easy application. The beveled tip of the liner allows precise contouring along the lips. Choose the same color as your lipstick for a seamless tone-on-tone finish.

how_to: An essential step before defining your lip contour Sharpen the lip liner before each use to ensure precise application. The Sephora Collection Pencil Sharpener comes with an adapter, allowing you to sharpen three different pencil diametres. It also includes a cleaning tool for effortless removal of shavings. What’s the best way to redefine your lip contour? With the 8H Colourful Lip Liner, you have endless options for transforming or exaggerating the shape of your lips. For a naturally defined look, simply follow the line of your lips. This gives you a discreet, natural result, making your lips more defined and the contour smoother while keeping its original shape. For fuller lips, either follow the natural shape of your lips by drawing a line slightly outside your contour or reshape your lips by filling in certain areas that are too thin (such as the ends). For rounded lips, follow the natural line of your lips at the corners, widen the line as you approach the centre, and then once you’ve reached the Cupid’s bow, extend the line beyond your natural contour. To accentuate this technique, apply a slightly darker liner to the outer corners and a lighter shade to the centre. The perfect combo for juicy lips this summer Pair the 8H Colourful Lip Liner with the Sephora Collection Totally Juicy Lip Tint, a glossy lip stain, for full and glossy lips!

how_to: The strongest colour payoff will be at the first point of brush contact to skin. Start application where the strongest colour impact is desired. For a natural rush of colour, gently buff colour onto skin using sweeping circular motions with #16 Blush Brush for more colour payoff or the Yachiyo Brush for softer colour payoff. For a seamless pop of colour, layer two shades of Blush. Start with a base colour in a shade that gives a subtle colour to the cheeks. Layer a brighter shade in a similar tone on the apples of the cheek, then blend edges to diffuse into base colour. For a touch-up or additional coverage, use a stippling motion when applying Blush to press colour onto skin without disrupting coverage already created.

how_to: What’s the best way to apply the nail polish? Here are a few tips for a successful manicure: Start by preparing the nail with a coat of base coat. To do so, position the applicator brush in the middle of the nail, by the cuticle. Paint the polish to the end of the nail. Leave to dry, then continue with a second coat to maximize coverage and shine. For a gel effect shine and longer wear, finish with the SEPHORA COLLECTION Top Coat. What’s the best way to remove a nail polish? This long wear nail polish can be removed with cotton soaked in nail polish remover. If you’re in a hurry, the express nail polish remover cleans the nails in 1 minute (1). Just turn your fingertip in its pre-soaked foam. (1) Satisfaction test with a red shade on 22 volunteers.

how_to: How to Apply the Retractable Brow Pencil? Use the ultra-precise tip to reshape your brows and fill in sparse areas for a naturally fuller look. Pro tip: Thanks to its fine tip, you can draw small, hair-like strokes that seamlessly blend with your natural brows for a more realistic finish. Apply in light strokes until you achieve the desired intensity. Use the brush to blend the formula and tame your brows. Tip: For a more defined result, start by outlining the desired shape with small strokes, then fill in with the pencil until you reach the perfect intensity. How to Remove Your Brow Makeup? Just like mascara, brow makeup requires a slightly different removal method. The eye contour area is delicate and sensitive, so avoid rubbing to remove brow pencil residue. The best approach: Use a gentle makeup remover like the Sephora Collection Waterproof Eye Makeup Remover with cornflower water, which effectively dissolves even the most long-wearing formulas.

how_to: What’s the best way to apply long-wear matte lipstick? Start at the cupid’s bow, then glide from the center to the corner of the lips. Repeat for the second half of the top lip. For the bottom lip, start at the corner and finish at the center. For a more defined effect, you can use a lip pencil around the edge to emphasize the curve.    What’s the best way to remove long-wear matte lipstick? Easily remove the lipstick using the Sephora Collection Melting Cleansing Balm.

how_to: Thin: Use the sharpest point of the tip to create fine, hair-like strokes. Medium: Use the end side of the pencil to create thicker, hair-like strokes. Wide: Use the pencil on its side to create broad strokes. For maximum control of the eyebrow pencil, expose a small bit of product (2-3 millimeters)—this will also help prevent overextension during application. Remember, all Anastasia Beverly Hills products are highly pigmented, so you only need a little pressure. When using Brow Definer, start by defining the eyebrow shape. Brush the hairs upward with the spoolie. Then, using the flat side of the pencil tip, outline the bottom of the eyebrow from arch to tail. Next, brush the hairs downward and outline the top of the eyebrow from arch to tail with the flat side. Brush the hairs back in place and fill in the eyebrow from arch to tail using the medium side of the tip. Next, detail the front of the eyebrow by creating hair-like strokes using the fine tip. Starting at the base of the front of the eyebrow, press the tip down and pull up in the direction of the hair’s growth. Use this eyebrow technique in areas where there is empty space. Continuously blend throughout.

how_to: How to apply: Step 1: brown freeze Working off the back of the cap, swirl Brow Freeze into the spoolie brush and remove excess before applying. On clean brows, brush a small amount of Brow Freeze through the brow using the spoolie brush to tame hairs into place. To lay brow hairs down flat, apply gentle pressing motions using the metal ferule (on the angled brush side) of Brush 7B. Keep Brow Freeze tightly sealed when not in use. Pro tip: To lay brow hairs down flat, apply gentle pressing motions using the metal ferule (on the angled brush side) of Brush 7B. Step 2: Brow Powder Duo Using Brush 7B, apply the deeper shade of Brow Powder Duo starting at the highest point of the brow (arch) and working towards the end. Using light pressure, apply the lighter shade of Brow Powder Duo through the front of the brow. Blend with the spoolie brush for a natural finish.

Focus on the T-zone (forehead, nose and chin) which are usually the shiniest areas. Use the Precision powder brush #59 to apply powder in the places that are most difficult to access, like the sides of the nose. With or without foundation? how_to: Can be applied with fingers, brush or sponge. Vary the amount of product used according to how much coverage is required. To apply with your fingers: 1. Put some foundation onto the back of your hand. 2. Put 4 little dabs of this foundation on your forehead, cheeks and chin, then spread from center to edges of face with little circular movements, not forgetting the neck. To apply with SEPHORA COLLECTION #01 FOUNDATION BRUSH: 1. Put some foundation onto the back of your hand. 2. Use a #01 FOUNDATION BRUSH to gently pat the product to warm it up and load the brush well. 3. Apply 4 small dabs of foundation to forehead, cheeks and chin, then spread from center to edges of face with little circular movements, not forgetting the neck. To apply with SEPHORA COLLECTION FLAWLESS COMPLEXION SPONGE:  1. Put some foundation onto the back of your hand. 2. Gently press a damp or dry FLAWLESS COMPLEXION SPONGE into the foundation on your hand. 3. Dab the foundation onto your skin with the sponge, then spread outwards with circular movements from center to edges of face, not forgetting the neck. 4. For a naturally blended effect, use the rounded part of the sponge. The pointed part is perfect for those hard-to-reach areas (around the eye, nose and mouth contours) and helps disguise little imperfections and dark circles.

how_to: How to apply your mascara  For maximum length and volume, position the brush at the base of the lashes and draw the product right up to the tips in a zigzag motion.  The spherical tip allows the brush to pivot to reach the inner and outer corners with precision. On the lower lashes, use the tip of the brush for more control. How to remove tubing mascara  This is one of its great advantages: No need to scrub! Simply wet your eyelashes with warm water, then slide and gently pinch your fingers along them. The small tubes will detach and dissolve on their own.

Next, draw along your lash line to meet your wing. Fill in the rest of the lash line using small strokes. To make application even easier, hold your mirror slightly below the eye so that when you’re drawing your liner, your lashes are down. Use a sticky note as a guide to get a clean, straight wing. Start by placing the sticky note edge along the lower lash line and angle it so it meets near the tail end of your brow. Use this edge as a guide to create your wing. Wait for the liner to set, then slowly peel away the sticky note. Hold your outer eye taut while applying the liner from the inner corner to the outer corner to make the glide smoother. For a seamless eye, use the precision tip to tight line your upper lash line. Shake well before use and store tip down to keep the ink flowing.

how_to: How to Use Apply the concealer under the eyes, over dark spots, redness, and blemishes. Blend using a brush or a damp sponge. Repeat as needed for additional coverage. For dark circles, lightly dot a shade lighter than your natural skin tone onto the inner corner of the under-eye and blend outwards. Apply your exact shade under the contour, beneath the brows, or on the nose and chin for a polished, lifted look.

how_to: How to choose the right shade for a flawless complexion? Each shade comprises a number and a letter. The number helps you choose the right shade for your complexion. The letter indicates the tone of the skin: P for pink: pink undertone N for neutral: neutral undertone Y for yellow: golden undertone How to apply BEST SKIN EVER using fingers for a flawless complexion? 1. Put some foundation onto the back of your hand. 2. Put 4 little dabs of this foundation on your forehead, cheeks and chin, then spread from center to edges of face with little circular movements, not forgetting the neck. Our tips for applying this beautiful skin foundation with a brush The perfect make-up partner? The #01 SEPHORA COLLECTION FOUNDATION BRUSH (vegan brush).   1. Put some foundation onto the back of your hand. 2. Use a #01 FOUNDATION BRUSH to gently pat the product to warm it up and load the brush well. 3. Apply 4 small dabs of foundation to forehead, cheeks and chin, then spread from center to edges of face with little circular movements, not forgetting the neck. How to apply this natural looking foundation using a complexion sponge? The perfect make-up partner? THE SEPHORA COLLECTION FLAWLESS COMPLEXION SPONGE. 1. Put some foundation onto the back of your hand. 2. Gently press a damp or dry FLAWLESS COMPLEXION SPONGE into the foundation on your hand. 3. Dab the foundation onto your skin with the sponge, then spread outwards with circular movements from center to edges of face, not forgetting the neck. 4. For a naturally blended effect, use the rounded part of the sponge. The pointed part is perfect for those hard-to-reach areas (around the eye, nose and mouth contours) and helps disguise little imperfections and dark circles.

how_to: Start by outlining the under arch of the brow, moving toward the tail end, then blend using a spoolie brush. Outline the upper arch and blend using a spoolie brush. To add detail and dimension, add hairlike strokes to the front of the brow. With the tip of the pencil, lightly sketch in the same direction as the hair’s natural growth. Use this technique on sparse areas throughout the brow and blend using a spoolie brush for a natural finish. Remember that all ABH products are highly pigmented, so little pressure is required when applying. When preparing to fill in the brow, use in a shade lighter than your natural hair colour to map out the three points of the Golden Ratio® along the brow to serve as guide points. When detailing the brow, always apply in the same direction as the hair’s natural growth. Use light pressure when applying. To achieve the hair-stroke technique, hold at a slant, lightly place the tip of the pencil onto the brow area, apply pressure at the bottom and then flick your wrist. This creates a follicle effect at the base. Layer different shades to create natural-looking multidimensional brows. First, fill in the brow with a lighter shade using brush 7b. Then, detail the brow with tiny hairlike strokes using a darker shade. For a quick application, first outline the shape of the brow (top and bottom), then blend the product through the brow using a spoolie brush. Warm up the fine-tipped pencil on the back of your hand; this allows for a creamy application. Use the hair-stroke technique to complete the brow look.
